name: iwdg_reset
description: IWDG_Reset: LSI measured by TIM16's input capture (TISEL: LSI on TI1), the IWDG set to time out after 1 s and refreshed every 990 ms while LD2 toggles. B1's handler (on the press: the BSP takes B1's rising edge, and B1 is active high) turns LD2 off and stores a word at 0x00040001, which its comment calls unmapped; on the G474RE's 512 KiB that address is inside the flash's boot alias, so the store reaches the flash interface with PG clear and sets PGSERR without a fault (RM0440 5.3.9), and the program goes on refreshing the IWDG: no reset. (On a 128 KiB part, the example's first target, the address is unmapped and the hard fault lets the IWDG reset it.)
